svg.title: NYC Taxi Data Engineering — M2.1 source identification
svg.desc: Manual M2.1 checks on the TLC sources, namely HEAD requests, reference downloads, PDF and CSV inspection, and SHA-256 recomputation, produce the source catalog, the staged reference files, the bundled reference descriptor, and the nyctaxi.contract Month and StorageLayout definitions used by M2.2 retrieval and M2.3 publication.

g.text: Manual checks on 19 September 2026, and how their results became Scala inputs for M2.2 and M2.3
